key_insight: A DVAE plus particle filter can track arc-welding state robustly by learning compact latent weld-pool dynamics and filtering out visual disturbances in real time.
engineering_relevance: This offers a generalizable monitoring framework for multiple arc-welding processes, reducing the need for process-specific tuning and large labeled datasets.
method: CNN encoder-decoder learns compact latent features from weld-pool images
LSTM transition model captures time-evolving welding dynamics under control inputs
Particle filter propagates latent and hidden states to suppress noise and preserve process history
evidence_signal: The framework was validated on GTAW and GMAW and reported to work without process-specific tuning, indicating cross-process generalizability and robustness.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of image sensing and the particle-filter design, especially under severe arc radiation or reflection conditions.
paper_title: Robust Monitoring of Arc Welding Processes: A Generalizable Framework with DVAE and Particle Filter
